div.p: For Homes & Businesses
Tell us what you need, from a few cases for home to regular supply for your business, and we will get back to you.
Six carefully controlled stages stand between raw water and the AQUÉRÉ bottle in your hand. Each one is monitored, so every drop meets the same standard of purity and safety.

li.p: Every journey begins with carefully selected raw water. Before it enters our plant, it is tested so that purification starts from a known, controlled baseline.
Sand and activated carbon filters remove suspended particles, sediment, odour and unwanted taste, preparing the water for fine purification.

ul.li: Sand filtration for particles and sediment
Activated carbon for odour and taste

li.p: Water is pushed through fine semi-permeable membranes that hold back dissolved impurities, bringing every batch to a clean and consistent standard.
Ultraviolet treatment and ozonation act as disinfection steps, helping to keep the purified water safe and fresh all the way to the bottle.
Clean bottles are filled and sealed in a controlled environment, minimising handling so the water reaches you exactly as it left our purification line.
Finished bottles are inspected and checked for quality before they are packed and dispatched, the last step in our promise of purity.

div.p: Quality Control
Quality is not a single test at the end. It is built in from the first drop to the sealed bottle. Test parameters, laboratory and certification details will be published here once confirmed.

article.p: Incoming water is checked before purification begins.
Each purification stage is monitored to keep quality consistent.
Sealed bottles are inspected before they leave our plant.
